title: Passes
description: Herb in Times Square at night, printed on warm paper with the passes a renderer keeps underneath it. Drag across the print and the photograph peels back sheet by sheet: a soft greyscale depth map, the surface normals that depth implies, and finally the street relit by a lamp that follows your hand, so the photo's own geometry catches a light that was never there. The sheets' edges step around herb where they cross him, and settle back into even bands when you let go.
intent: Reality pieces: the layers under a captured image, after Unreal's buffer visualization (https://dev.epicgames.com/documentation/en-us/unreal-engine/viewport-modes-in-unreal-engine), photogrammetry tools like Polycam and RealityScan, and Thomas Ruff's jpegs, where the image's structure becomes the image. Depth by Depth Anything V2, normals baked from it offline.
